metric_policy.complete_package_note: Complete package includes generated MBIST wrappers, algorithms, saboteur/model RTL, and staged SRAM behavioral models.
metric_policy.storage_note: Unpacked behavioral memory arrays are reported as memory_bit_count, not flipflop_count.

registers.name: REG0_LIVE_FAULTS
registers.description: Packed live fault indicators. Bit 0=input range fault, bit 1=request outstanding, bit 2=response valid, bit 3=stale reject, bit 4=timeout, bit 5=clamp active, bit 6=fallback active, bit 7=reserved.

fields.name: FAULT_INPUT_RANGE
fields.description: Current input-range fault status; asserted when flow_conditions_velocity_mps is outside 20..55 m/s inclusive.

fields.name: FAULT_REQUEST_OUTSTANDING
fields.description: Indicates a request is outstanding and awaiting a matching response.

fields.name: FAULT_RESPONSE_VALID
fields.description: Indicates the current response path has observed a valid response event.

fields.name: FAULT_STALE_REJECT
fields.description: Indicates a stale, duplicated, or out-of-order response was rejected.

fields.name: FAULT_TIMEOUT
fields.description: Indicates the outstanding request exceeded the configured timeout.

fields.name: FAULT_CLAMP_ACTIVE
fields.description: Indicates one or more actuator commands were saturated to configured min/max limits.

fields.name: FAULT_FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Indicates safe fallback is currently active.

registers.name: REG1_STICKY_FAULTS
registers.description: Packed sticky fault indicators retained until reset. Bit 0=input range fault, bit 1=request outstanding, bit 2=response valid, bit 3=stale reject, bit 4=timeout, bit 5=clamp active, bit 6=fallback active, bit 7=reserved.

fields.name: STICKY_FAULT_INPUT_RANGE
fields.description: Latched history of input-range fault.

fields.name: STICKY_FAULT_REQUEST_OUTSTANDING
fields.description: Latched history of request-outstanding fault or condition.

fields.name: STICKY_FAULT_RESPONSE_VALID
fields.description: Latched history of valid response observation.

fields.name: STICKY_FAULT_STALE_REJECT
fields.description: Latched history of stale or out-of-order response rejection.

fields.name: STICKY_FAULT_TIMEOUT
fields.description: Latched history of timeout.

fields.name: STICKY_FAULT_CLAMP_ACTIVE
fields.description: Latched history of clamp saturation.

fields.name: STICKY_FAULT_FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Latched history of fallback activation.

registers.name: REG2_REQUEST_SEQ_LO
registers.description: Current diagnostic request sequence number, little-endian byte lane 0.

fields.name: DIAGNOSTIC_REQUEST_SEQ[7:0]
fields.description: Lower 8 bits of the monotonic request sequence counter.

registers.name: REG3_REQUEST_SEQ_HI
registers.description: Current diagnostic request sequence number, little-endian byte lane 1.

fields.name: DIAGNOSTIC_REQUEST_SEQ[15:8]
fields.description: Upper 8 bits of the monotonic request sequence counter.

registers.name: REG4_RESPONSE_SEQ_LO
registers.description: Most recently accepted or observed response sequence number, little-endian byte lane 0.

fields.name: DIAGNOSTIC_RESPONSE_SEQ[7:0]
fields.description: Lower 8 bits of the response sequence tracking register.

registers.name: REG5_RESPONSE_SEQ_HI
registers.description: Most recently accepted or observed response sequence number, little-endian byte lane 1.

fields.name: DIAGNOSTIC_RESPONSE_SEQ[15:8]
fields.description: Upper 8 bits of the response sequence tracking register.

fields.name: DIAGNOSTIC_TIMEOUT_COUNTER[7:0]
fields.description: Lower 8 bits of the timeout counter.

fields.name: DIAGNOSTIC_TIMEOUT_COUNTER[15:8]
fields.description: Upper 8 bits of the timeout counter.

registers.name: REG8_OUTSTANDING_AND_AGE_LO
registers.description: Outstanding request flag and response age, little-endian byte lane 0.

fields.name: DIAGNOSTIC_OUTSTANDING
fields.description: Indicates whether a request is currently outstanding.

fields.name: DIAGNOSTIC_RESPONSE_AGE[14:8]
fields.description: Upper 7 bits of response age.

fields.name: DIAGNOSTIC_RESPONSE_AGE[7:0]
fields.description: Lower 8 bits of response age.

fields.name: REQUEST_VALID
fields.description: Registered request_valid transaction indicator.

fields.name: SAFE_FALLBACK_REQUEST
fields.description: Registered safe fallback request indicator.

fields.name: REQUEST_OUTSTANDING
fields.description: Summary indication that a request is outstanding.

fields.name: RESPONSE_VALID_EVENT
fields.description: Summary indication that a response has been accepted or observed as valid.

fields.name: STALE_REJECT_EVENT
fields.description: Summary indication that a stale response was rejected.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_EVENT
fields.description: Summary indication that a timeout has occurred.

fields.name: CLAMP_EVENT
fields.description: Summary indication that output clamping occurred.

fields.name: FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Summary indication that fallback is active.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_COMMAND0[7:0]
fields.description: Lower 8 bits of actuator_command0.
